title: Milestones use full version numbers
summary: GitHub milestones now carry full version numbers instead of v0.N.x: closed lines show the last version they shipped and open lines show their projected final version, and the agent docs and milestone migration script follow the new convention.
changes: Rename closed milestones to their last shipped version (for example v0.38.9 Beta) and open milestones to a projected final version (for example v0.40.7 Beta).
Fold the nav cleanup issue into the 0.39 milestone and remove the empty 0.40 placeholder, so the open lines run v0.40.7, v0.41.7, v0.42.11 and v0.43.10.
Derive milestone titles in migrate-beta-milestones.sh from the highest version in releases.json and rename legacy v0.N.x titles in place.
Document the full-version milestone convention in AGENTS.md, the GitHub issues rule, the task issue template, the ship-gate skill and the release-metadata design spec.
affected_areas: Release ops scripts and agent documentation
version_rationale: Patch on the completed 0.39.x line: repository and GitHub hygiene only; no application feature changes.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
Verified every milestone title against releases.json with the GitHub milestones API.
known_limitations: Open milestone titles are projections and are renamed by hand when their scope changes; the migration script only manages closed lines.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Milestone titles can be renamed back on GitHub; documentation and script changes do not alter runtime application behaviour.
